t: Section 3707(a) is amended by striking “demonstration project under this section during fiscal years 1993 through 2012” and inserting “project under this section”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that strikes the phrase limiting a demonstration project to fiscal years 1993 through 2012 and replaces it with "project under this section", making the program permanent. A tempting reading is that the underlying project might involve outside parties, but the text here creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with non-federal entities, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is brought into any federal decision.
